1:
The number $\log_9 27 + \log_9 3$ equals
A. 81  B. 9  C. 4  D. 2
2:
The number $\sqrt[3]{-\frac{27}{16}}\cdot\sqrt[3]{2}$ equals
A. $-\frac32$  B. $\frac32$  C. $\frac23$  D. $-\frac23$
3:
The price of a camera was reduced by 15%, and then by 20% relative to the price at that time. After these two reductions the camera costs 340 PLN. Before both reductions the price of this camera was equal to
A. 500 PLN  B. 425 PLN  C. 400 PLN  D. 375 PLN
7:
One of the solutions of the equation $\sqrt3(x^2-2)(x+3)=0$ is the number
A. 3  B. 2  C. $\sqrt3$  D. $\sqrt2$
9:
The zero of the linear function $f(x)=(2p-1)x+p$ is the number $(-4)$. Then
A. $p=\frac{4}{9}$  B. $p=\frac{4}{7}$  C. $p=-4$  D. $p=-\frac{4}{7}$
13:
In the coordinate system $(x,y)$ the graph of the function $y=f(x)$ is drawn (see figure). [Figure: $f(x)=2$ for $x\in\langle-6,-3)$ (closed at $-6$, open at $-3$); a segment from $(-3,-3)$ (closed) to $(1,1)$ (closed); from $(1,5)$ (open) horizontal to $(2,5)$, then a segment down to $(5,3)$ (closed).] The greatest value of the function $f$ on the interval $\langle-4,1\rangle$ equals
A. $0$  B. $1$  C. $2$  D. $5$
14:
One of the zeros of the quadratic function f is the number $(-5)$. The first coordinate of the vertex of the parabola that is the graph of f equals 3. The other zero of f is the number
A. 11  B. 1  C. $(-1)$  D. $(-13)$
15:
The sequence $(a_n)$ is defined by $a_n=2^n\cdot(n+1)$ for every natural number $n\ge1$. The term $a_4$ equals
A. 64  B. 40  C. 48  D. 80
16:
The three-term sequence $(27,9,a-1)$ is geometric. The number a equals
A. 3  B. 0  C. 4  D. 2
17:
In the coordinate system an angle $\alpha$ with vertex at $O=(0,0)$ is marked. One arm of the angle lies on the positive half-axis $Ox$, and the other passes through the point $P=(-3,1)$ (see figure). The tangent of angle $\alpha$ equals
A. $\frac{1}{\sqrt{10}}$  B. $\left(-\frac{3}{\sqrt{10}}\right)$  C. $\left(-\frac{3}{1}\right)$  D. $\left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)$
19:
[Figure: points A, B, C on a circle with center O; angle ACO = 70 deg] The acute angle ABC has measure
A. 10°  B. 20°  C. 35°  D. 40°
20:
In a rhombus with side length $6\sqrt2$ the obtuse angle has measure 150 deg. The product of the diagonals of this rhombus equals
A. 24  B. 72  C. 36  D. $36\sqrt2$
21:
[Figure: tangent lines to a circle with center O through points A and B meet at C; angle AOB = 140 deg] The measure of angle ACB equals
A. 20°  B. 35°  C. 40°  D. 70°

[Figure: triangle ABC with |BC|=6, angle ACB = 150 deg] The height of triangle ABC dropped from vertex B equals
A. 3  B. 4  C. $3\sqrt3$  D. $4\sqrt3$
23:
The line k has equation $y=-\frac13x+2$. The line with equation $y=ax+b$ is parallel to line k and passes through point P=(3,5) when
A. $a=3$ and $b=4$  B. $a=-\frac13$ and $b=4$  C. $a=3$ and $b=-4$  D. $a=-\frac13$ and $b=6$
24:
Points K=(-3,-7) and S=(5,3) are given. Point S is the midpoint of segment KL. Then point L has coordinates
A. $(13,10)$  B. $(13,13)$  C. $(1,-2)$  D. $(7,-1)$
26:
A regular quadrilateral prism has a base edge of length 15. The diagonal of the prism is inclined to the base plane at an angle alpha such that $\cos\alpha=\frac{\sqrt2}{3}$. The length of the prism's diagonal equals
A. $15\sqrt2$  B. 45  C. $5\sqrt2$  D. 10
27:
The arithmetic mean of numbers x,y,z equals 4. The arithmetic mean of the four numbers $1+x, 2+y, 3+z, 14$ equals
A. 6  B. 9  C. 8  D. 13
28:
The number of all 5-digit natural numbers whose decimal representation uses only the digits 0,5,7 (e.g. 57075, 55555) equals
A. $5^3$  B. $2\cdot4^3$  C. $2\cdot3^4$  D. $3^5$
31: Mr Stanislaw paid off a loan of 8910 PLN in eighteen installments. Each successive installment was smaller than the previous one by 30 PLN. Calculate the amount of the first installment.
33: Right triangles $T_1$ and $T_2$ are similar. The legs of triangle $T_1$ have lengths 5 and 12. The hypotenuse of triangle $T_2$ has length 26. Calculate the area of triangle $T_2$.
35: From the set of eight numbers $\{2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9\}$ two numbers are drawn with replacement, one at a time. Calculate the probability of event A: the product of the drawn numbers is divisible by 15.
36: [Figure: right prism ABCDEF with isosceles triangular base ABC] The base of the right prism ABCDEF is an isosceles triangle ABC with |AC|=|BC|, |AB|=8. The height of triangle ABC from vertex C has length 3. The diagonal CE of the lateral face forms a 60 deg angle with base edge CB. Calculate the total surface area and the volume of this prism.
